summary: Directed to attempt Phase 6's six-site IReuseContain_mono wiring FIRST rather than survey for a fifth round of scaffolding (four prior dispatches had each found a new prerequisite gap and stopped without attempting the wiring itself). This dispatch did attempt it and closed Phase 6 in full across two commits. First: closed a genuine fourth gap, intStepBranchPrio_newEdge_frozen (Expansion.lean) -- the 'record-time checkpoint' IReuseFrozenOrigin_snoc's own docstring named but no prior dispatch had actually landed as a lemma, closed via a three-lemma chain proving that whenever intStepBranchPrio plants a new edge, its first (non-world-creating) pass must have returned none. Second: threaded IAllReuseFrozenOrigin through intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat's outer signature and key's full 10-case induction (item d), discovering two more small lemmas while attempting the wiring (IReuseFrozenOrigin_labelBound, IReuseFrozenOrigin_widen) -- committed as its own green checkpoint. Third: attempting item (e) surfaced a FIFTH gap -- IReuseFrozenOrigin as landed did not store the origin's own containment fact, so it could propagate a freeze bound but not derive IReuseContain. Fixed by adding one more existential conjunct plus one new corollary (IReuseFrozenOrigin_reuseContain), which collapsed the plan's anticipated six bespoke case-split proofs into one uniform substitution per site -- a genuine, favorable simplification over the original decomposition, found only by attempting the wiring as instructed. IReuseContain restated to the plan's target bare form; IReuseContain_mono and IReuseContain_snoc removed (subsumed). Phase 6 heading marked [COMPLETED] with full task-list checked off and deviations recorded. Full CI pipeline green after each commit (lake build 3325 jobs, checkInitImports, lake lint zero Scheme.lean findings, lint-style, shake, mk_all, lake test 9397 jobs run in the foreground). Sorry count 196->196, axiom count 26->26, both unchanged; intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat re-verified via lean_verify with no sorryAx.

decisions_made: Attempted the six-site wiring directly per the dispatch instruction, rather than opening with another survey for a new prerequisite gap -- the instruction was explicit that a fourth machinery-building dispatch would be the wrong outcome.

Closed the fourth gap (intStepBranchPrio_newEdge_frozen) as a small, self-contained three-lemma chain in Expansion.lean before touching Scheme.lean's induction, since the case6 site's IReuseFrozenOrigin_snoc call cannot be constructed without it.

Split the remaining work into two independently-committable waves: item (d) (pure threading, additive, does not touch IReuseContain's definition or the six _mono call sites) landed and verified green first; items (e)/(f) (which DO change IReuseContain's definition, breaking all six _mono call sites simultaneously) landed second. This matches the commit-per-green-substep mandate and would have left a strong, honest partial-progress checkpoint even if item (e)/(f) had hit a genuine wall.

When item (e) surfaced the fifth gap (IReuseFrozenOrigin missing the origin's own containment fact), chose to fix the design (add one conjunct, one corollary) rather than fall back to the plan's originally-envisioned six bespoke case-split proofs -- the corollary route is strictly simpler once the origin's containment fact is available, since IReuseFrozenOrigin's existential already carries the 'already-present vs. newly-arrived' split internally via hagree/hcont_o/hmono.

Removed IReuseContain_mono and IReuseContain_snoc entirely rather than keeping stale/dead-but-compiling wrappers, since neither is used anywhere after the corollary-based rewiring and the plan's own Tasks list anticipated IReuseContain_snoc might not survive unchanged.

Investigated an apparent sorryAx regression flagged by lean_verify mid-dispatch (intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat showing sorryAx after item-(d) threading); confirmed via a controlled A/B check (swap in the pre-dispatch file, rebuild, re-verify, swap back) that it was a stale LSP diagnostic cache artifact, not a real regression -- a fresh lake build + re-verify showed clean axioms both before and after. Recorded in the handoff so a future dispatch does not re-chase this.
dead_ends: Did not attempt to keep IReuseContain_mono provable by weakening IReuseContain's restatement -- the plan is explicit that the bare form is the target and any weakening would defeat Phase 6's purpose.

Did not attempt a per-site bespoke transport proof (the plan's originally-sketched shape for item (e)) once the fifth gap was found -- recognized that the missing origin-containment conjunct was the more fundamental fix and that adding it would make every site's proof uniform, rather than writing six separate ad hoc arguments.
